description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司的限售解禁汇总数据。可按股票代码批量查询，返回最新数据日期、最新限售股数量/占总股本比、未来1年解禁数量/占总股本比/解禁市值等数据。当用户想查询某段时间下限售解禁数据变化最大的前N家公司、或者查询某上市公司或者对比某些上市公司在不同周期下的限售股解禁数量和占股本比的统计数据，查询公司解禁压力时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain restricted share unlock (限售解禁) data for A-share stocks. Supports batch query by stock code, returning fields such as latest data date, latest restricted share quantity/percentage of total capital, unlock quantity/percentage of total capital/market value in the next year, and more. Call this interface when users want to assess the unlock pressure of restricted shares for an A-share or query future unlock schedules.
